0022600166.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, losers of two straight, 14th in the East) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, 10th in the West) in a regular-season game, with the Bucks on the road for the seventh time this season. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while LaMelo Ball (wrist) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
